```plato
    // The signed distance from a point to an axis-aligned box with the given
    // half-extents, centred at the origin. The exterior part is the length of the
    // positive per-axis surface offsets, the interior part the largest (least
    // negative) offset. Exact. (IQ: sdBox.)
    DistanceToBox(p: Point3D, halfExtents: Vector3D): Number {
        var q = Vector3D(
            p.X.Abs - halfExtents.X,
            p.Y.Abs - halfExtents.Y,
            p.Z.Abs - halfExtents.Z);
        return Vector3D(q.X.Max(0.0), q.Y.Max(0.0), q.Z.Max(0.0)).Magnitude
             + q.X.Max(q.Y.Max(q.Z)).Min(0.0);
    }
```

## Line 1046

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato, line 1046](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/implicit-sdf.library.plato#L1046).

```plato

    // The signed distance from a point to an axis-aligned rectangle with the given
    // half-extents, centred at the origin. Exterior is the length of the positive
    // per-axis offsets, interior the least negative one. Exact. (IQ: sdBox.)
    DistanceToBox(p: Point2D, halfExtents: Vector2D): Number {
        var q = Vector2D(p.X.Abs - halfExtents.X, p.Y.Abs - halfExtents.Y);
        return Vector2D(q.X.Max(0.0), q.Y.Max(0.0)).Magnitude
             + q.X.Max(q.Y).Min(0.0);
    }
```
